description: Angular component for a notification template dialog in the Thingsboard UI, managing notification template creation/editing with form controls, stepper navigation, and notification type handling.

classes.name: TemplateNotificationDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for managing notification template dialog, extending TemplateConfiguration, handling form logic, stepper navigation, and notification type permissions.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions when component is destroyed.

methods.name: changeStep
methods.description: Handles step change in the stepper component.

methods.name: nextStep
methods.description: Advances to the next step or adds the notification template if on last step.

methods.name: nextStepLabel
methods.description: Returns label for the next step button based on current step.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Saves the notification template via service and closes dialog.

methods.name: allValid
methods.description: Validates all step controls before proceeding.

methods.name: isSysAdmin
methods.description: Checks if current user has SYS_ADMIN authority.

methods.name: allowNotificationType
methods.description: Determines allowed notification types based on user authority.
